name: service_tow_b
prompt:
Image 1 is a finished sprite sheet of nine tow trucks for a 2D top-down city game, seen straight down from above, each with its nose to the right. Only the transparent areas of the mask are redrawn: the places of truck 1 (top row, left) and truck 2 (top row, middle). Redraw each of those two trucks in its place at the same size and outline, matching the other seven trucks of image 1 exactly in art style, outline weight, shading, livery and detail — truck 3 beside them is the model.

- The last drawing put the row of round work lamps ON THE CAB ROOF of trucks 1 and 2: wrong. The cab roof behind the windscreen is plain yellow painted metal with NOTHING on it, about 0.6 m long, as truck 3's is. The work lamps belong on the dark steel headboard that stands BEHIND the cab, across the front of the deck, as on trucks 3 to 9.
- Behind the headboard: the framed dark diamond-plate deck with tie-down slots, red and white hazard stripes down both long sides and across the tail, and a red tail lamp at each rear corner — as the other trucks have.
- Truck 1 is a Soviet forward-control 4×4: a flat bonnetless front with round headlamps, the windscreen at the very front. Truck 2 is a 2000s Japanese off-road 4×4: a flat square bonnet.
- No crane, boom or arm. The glass dark, every lamp switched off, no text, letters, numbers or logos.

Background: fully transparent outside the trucks — no colour, no glow or halo, no shadow. Everything outside the masked areas stays as it is.
